findings.desc: CHK-002:happy:0 is not covered by real two-host evidence. checklist_get records only a manual_transcript with command "claude --print ...; codex exec -s read-only ..." and no file/transcript artifact; evidence_inspect confirms the only transcriptRef for this intent is checklist.verificationEvidence.
